cmd:
set -euo pipefail
cd /ssd6/hungwei/icpe-next/main-ana
export RUN_ID=20261106-110854-icpe-main-verB-p1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
PY="nice -n 19 /ssd6/hungwei/icpe-next/venv/bin/python -I"
O=/ssd6/hungwei/icpe-next/runs/20261106-110854-icpe-main-verB-p1/out
B=results/icpe_next/b
VA=results/icpe_next/main/verA
AN=code/icpe/next_sim_analyze.py
TTL4="TTLA:1 TTLA:3 TTLA:30 TTLA:100 TTLB:1 TTLB:3 TTLB:30 TTLB:100"
fam() {  # 每類紀錄的 sweep：M＝main（3 個 TTL）、T＝P1 _ttl（8 個新 TTL）、R＝P1 _trunc（截尾）；不含 cw_main_ttl7／sa_main_ttl7
  case $1 in
    cw) M="$B/cw_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz"; T="$B/cw_p1/*_ttl/x1_sweep.csv.xz"; R="$B/cw_p1/*_trunc/x1_sweep.csv.xz";;
    tl) M="$B/tl_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz"; T="$B/tl_p1/*_ttl/x1_sweep.csv.xz"; R="$B/tl_p1/*_trunc/x1_sweep.csv.xz";;
    sa) M="$B/sa_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz"; T="$B/sa_p1/*_ttl/x1_sweep.csv.xz"; R="$B/sa_p1/*_trunc/x1_sweep.csv.xz";;
    bl) M="$B/bl_main/bailian3/x1_sweep.csv.xz"; T="$B/bl_p1/bailian3_ttl/x1_sweep.csv.xz"; R="$B/bl_p1/bailian3_trunc/x1_sweep.csv.xz";;
    mc) M="$B/old_main/mooncake/x1_sweep.csv.xz"; T="$B/old_p1/mooncake_ttl/x1_sweep.csv.xz"; R="$B/old_p1/mooncake_trunc/x1_sweep.csv.xz";;
    fi) M="$B/old_main/fi6w/x1_sweep.csv.xz"; T="$B/old_p1/fi6w_ttl/x1_sweep.csv.xz"; R="$B/old_p1/fi6w_trunc/x1_sweep.csv.xz";;
  esac
}
FAMS="cw tl sa bl mc fi"
# 1. 列數核對（開算前；少了就停）：main 17 CPU × 8 GPU、_ttl 15 CPU × 8 GPU、_trunc 6 CPU × 16 GPU，每個 (trace, rule) 都 54 格
for f in $FAMS; do fam $f
  $PY code/icpe/main_rowcheck.py --label ${f}_main --sweep $M --expect-cells 54 --expect-cpu 17 --expect-gpu 8 --out $O/rowcheck.csv
  $PY code/icpe/main_rowcheck.py --label ${f}_p1_ttl --sweep $T --expect-cells 54 --expect-cpu 15 --expect-gpu 8 --out $O/rowcheck.csv
  $PY code/icpe/main_rowcheck.py --label ${f}_p1_trunc --sweep $R --expect-cells 54 --expect-cpu 6 --expect-gpu 16 --out $O/rowcheck.csv
done
# 2. 重疊列核對（使用者 11/6）：舊的 ttl7 補跑和 P1 _ttl 是同一個設定，重疊的列要逐格相同
$PY code/icpe/main_overlap.py --name cw_main_ttl7_vs_cw_p1_ttl --a $B/cw_main_ttl7/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz --b $B/cw_p1/*_ttl/x1_sweep.csv.xz --out $O/overlap.csv
# sa_main_ttl7 只有 cells.csv、沒有 sweep（STATUS_DATA 08:10：沒跑，改跑 sa_p1）→ SemiAnalysis 沒有可核對的重疊列（NOT_MEASURED）；上一個 run 20261106-110735 因這行 FileNotFoundError 停下
# 3. 上限表（next_sim_analyze.py 不改；每類分開跑）
for f in $FAMS; do fam $f
  $PY $AN --sweep $M $T --out-dir $O --out-prefix ${f}_p1 --pf-target cpu                                  # 版本 B 正式：7 個 TTL ④② 都有
  $PY $AN --sweep $M $T --out-dir $O --out-prefix ${f}_p1dev5 --pf-target cpu --rival-only-gpu $TTL4       # 偏離 5 的算法（並列）
  $PY $AN --sweep $M $T $R --out-dir $O --out-prefix ${f}_p1h1800 --pf-target cpu --dead-h 1800            # 只報告
  $PY $AN --sweep $M $T $R --out-dir $O --out-prefix ${f}_p1h3600 --pf-target cpu --dead-h 3600            # 只報告
  $PY $AN --sweep $M $T --out-dir $O --out-prefix ${f}_p1_p90 --pf-target cpu --metric p90_ret             # 只報告（PREREG §1）
done
# 4. 逐格關係核對（必然成立；不成立就停）
for f in $FAMS; do
  $PY code/icpe/main_ab.py cells --name ${f}_B_OGPU_le_A --x $O/${f}_p1_headroom_components.csv --y $VA/${f}_ttl3_headroom_components.csv.xz --rel le --component O-GPU --out $O/cellcheck.csv
  $PY code/icpe/main_ab.py cells --name ${f}_dev5_le_A --x $O/${f}_p1dev5_headroom_components.csv --y $VA/${f}_ttl3_headroom_components.csv.xz --rel le --out $O/cellcheck.csv
  $PY code/icpe/main_ab.py cells --name ${f}_B_eq_dev5_OGPU_OALL --x $O/${f}_p1_headroom_components.csv --y $O/${f}_p1dev5_headroom_components.csv --rel eq --component O-GPU "O-ALL(report)" --out $O/cellcheck.csv
  for h in 1800 3600; do
    $PY code/icpe/main_ab.py cells --name ${f}_h${h}_eq_B_untruncated --x $O/${f}_p1h${h}_headroom_components.csv --y $O/${f}_p1_headroom_components.csv --rel eq --component O-ORD O-PF O-GPU --out $O/cellcheck.csv
  done
done
# 5. 彙總與判定
SW="$B/cw_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz $B/tl_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz $B/sa_main/*/x1_sweep.csv.xz $B/bl_main/bailian3/x1_sweep.csv.xz $B/old_main/mooncake/x1_sweep.csv.xz $B/old_main/fi6w/x1_sweep.csv.xz"
hr() { echo "CacheWise=$O/cw_$1_headroom_components.csv TraceLab=$O/tl_$1_headroom_components.csv SemiAnalysis=$O/sa_$1_headroom_components.csv Bailian=$O/bl_$1_headroom_components.csv Mooncake=$O/mc_$1_headroom_components.csv FreeInference=$O/fi_$1_headroom_components.csv"; }
$PY code/icpe/main_summary.py --version "B: P1 formal (dev6) - main + _p1 _ttl, 7 TTLs in both oracle and rival, no --rival-only-gpu, cw/sa_main_ttl7 not used" --headroom $(hr p1) --sweep $SW --out-dir $O --out-prefix verB
$PY code/icpe/main_summary.py --version "B_dev5: same inputs, dev5 algorithm (--rival-only-gpu 8 new TTLs) - reported alongside, not the formal verdict" --headroom $(hr p1dev5) --sweep $SW --out-dir $O --out-prefix verB_dev5
$PY code/icpe/main_summary.py --report-only --version "B_h1800: --dead-h 1800 (report only)" --headroom $(hr p1h1800) --sweep $SW --out-dir $O --out-prefix verB_h1800
$PY code/icpe/main_summary.py --report-only --version "B_h3600: --dead-h 3600 (report only)" --headroom $(hr p1h3600) --sweep $SW --out-dir $O --out-prefix verB_h3600
$PY code/icpe/main_summary.py --report-only --version "B_p90 (report only)" --headroom $(hr p1_p90) --sweep $SW --out-dir $O --out-prefix verB_p90
# 6. 版本 A／B 並列（格數必須相同）
$PY code/icpe/main_ab.py table --bytrace A_ttl3=$VA/verA_ttl3_by_trace.csv A_report=$VA/verA_report_by_trace.csv B=$O/verB_by_trace.csv B_dev5=$O/verB_dev5_by_trace.csv B_h1800=$O/verB_h1800_by_trace.csv B_h3600=$O/verB_h3600_by_trace.csv \
  --verdict A_ttl3=$VA/verA_ttl3_verdict.csv A_report=$VA/verA_report_verdict.csv B=$O/verB_verdict.csv B_dev5=$O/verB_dev5_verdict.csv --out-dir $O --out-prefix verAB
# 7. 論文的兩個 Mooncake 舊測試：補新模擬器版本 B（含截尾 H3600）
$PY code/icpe/main_oldtests.py \
  --src old_V0_noGPUtier=results/icpe_h200/t1/p01/sim_V0/x1/x1_headroom_components.csv old_V1_noGPUtier=results/icpe_h200/t1/p01/sim_V1/x1/x1_headroom_components.csv new_verA_ttl3=$VA/mc_ttl3_headroom_components.csv.xz new_verB_p1=$O/mc_p1_headroom_components.csv \
  --src-h3600 old_V0_noGPUtier=results/icpe_h200/t1/p01/sim_V0/x1/x1h3600_headroom_components.csv old_V1_noGPUtier=results/icpe_h200/t1/p01/sim_V1/x1/x1h3600_headroom_components.csv new_verB_p1=$O/mc_p1h3600_headroom_components.csv \
  --check-v0 old_V0_noGPUtier --out-dir $O --out-prefix oldtests_verB
